title: cinna glomerata
intro: Cinna glomerata, commonly known as sweet grass, is a perennial grass native to North America. This plant is valued for its sweet, vanillalike fragrance and its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cinna glomerata include soothing digestive issues, reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of sweet grass include essential oils, particularly cinnamaldehyde, linalool, and geraniol, which contribute to its medicinal and aromatic properties.
